content: Also, some researchers, introduced a combined model based on traditional collaborative filtering and topic modeling and designed a novel algorithm to scientific articles recommendation for users from an online community, called CTR model. They considered LDA to initialize the CTR model, Infact they combined the matrix factorization and the LDA model, and is shown their approach better than the recommendations based on matrix factorization. For evaluation and test, Used a large dataset from a bibliography sharing service (CiteULike) BIBREF47. Table 1, shown some impressive work based on LDA for paper recommendation.
